review: Confirm 68 Active plus 2 Notice Period employees for the first pay month. Exclude 57 Inactive unless final pay is approved.
Approve Country-Based Employee ID (VN column E). Resolve changes against existing employees before importing.
Approve BK gross VND salary and effective date. Review net/foreign-currency exceptions.
Review date anomalies, Indefinite end dates, probation dates, department and manager names.
Review fixed transport, phone, other allowance, insurance base, UI region cap and participation flags.
Set Resident or Manual mode and registered dependents. Nonresident, short-term, net-to-gross and special tax cases use reviewed manual PIT.
Approve overtime exemption, phone/transport treatment and reimbursements. No automatic blanket exemption.
Confirm actual bonus and 13th-month payment policy. HC targets and 2026 estimates do not create monthly earnings.
Validate balances in leave module. Sheet4 has no headers or period; it is not a paid-days source.
Dependent sheet has names, inconsistent relationship labels and a placeholder row. Add country employee ID, dates and eligibility before import.
After validation, apply approved record changes through Records Desk, assign the new scheme, generate the populated monthly download, and compare a parallel draft.
